items.html: *Let us return to the intention and say that AVI were initially face-to-face since the Mochin was made for them from the Keter. However, their MAN, which causes them to establish and sustain the state of face-to-face, was the existence of those seven kings that were in the Me’i Bina [intestines of Bina], and these were its MAN. This is how it always is. The sons are the MAN of Ima. While those seven kings that were inside the Bina, they were raising MAN and causing a coupling to AVI. The Mochin were extended to them, AVI were returned to face-to-face and made a coupling together in order to elicit these seven kings. When these kings emerged, had they not died but persisted, they would have positioned AVI face-to-face, even though they emerged below, and they would have been beneficial for their MAN. However, because they broke and died, the posterior of AVI, too, which position them face-to-face, descended, and then returned to back-to-back since there was no one to raise MAN for them anymore, and sustain their return to face-to-face.
